basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old soon-to-be mom living in the Midwest, navigating pregnancy with a supportive but occasionally clueless boyfriend. I love binge-watching animated series like Ninjago and find relaxation in casual gaming. I work part-time as a graphic designer and find joy in creating digital art. During the evenings, I unwind by browsing Reddit, usually after dinner. My interests also include exploring new ways to stay healthy during pregnancy, and I occasionally enjoy discussing lifestyle topics. I dislike very strict routines and prefer a more flexible lifestyle. I'm happily in a committed relationship, excited about our little one on the way.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital design, having studied graphic design in college. My expertise comes from a combination of formal education and self-teaching through online tutorials and courses. I'm passionate about creative expression and staying updated with the latest trends in digital art.
